validity_domain.condition: Direct Standard Model interactions vanish only if hidden SU(3)_H remains unbroken.
Relic scenarios are split into M much greater than M_Zprime and M much less than M_Zprime, with and without inflation.
For M much less than M_Zprime without inflation, relativistic decoupling gives M less than about 3 keV.

global.description: The singlet has only U(1)_Z-mediated interactions with the Standard Model once hidden SU(3)_H is unbroken.
The U(1)_Z gauge symmetry breaks somewhere between the weak scale and the Planck scale.
Inflation may or may not dilute the original abundance; the allowed region depends on reheating.
